body.html:
The UESCA partnership

augo partners with UESCA to support the coaches it certifies. If you hold a UESCA certification, you get 10% off your first 6 months on augo. The first 20 UESCA coaches also get the Elite add-on free for 3 months.

There's no code to enter at checkout. You subscribe as normal, send us your certificate, and we apply the offer to your account.

steps.title: Subscribe to augo
steps.html: Sign up and subscribe to augo Pro the usual way. You don't need to wait for the discount before you start.

steps.title: Email us your certificate
steps.html: Send your UESCA certificate, as a PDF or a screenshot, to info@augotraining.com. Include the email address you use for your augo account so we can find it.

steps.title: We apply the discount
steps.html: We add the 10% discount to your subscription for your first 6 months and confirm by email.

body.html:
Free Elite for the first 20 UESCA coaches

The first 20 UESCA-certified coaches who ask get the Elite add-on free for 3 months. To claim it, ask for the Elite upgrade in your email to info@augotraining.com. It can be the same email as your certificate or a separate one.

Spots go in the order requests arrive, and we'll reply to tell you whether one is still available. After the 3 months, you can keep Elite at the normal price or remove it.

What the Elite tier is

Elite is an optional add-on to augo Pro for coaches who want dedicated support as their coaching business grows. It includes:

  • A dedicated account executive, your direct contact at augo.
  • AI consulting and training, to help you get more out of augo and AI in your coaching.
  • Your choice of AI model: Claude Sonnet, Claude Opus, Gemini or ChatGPT.

Pro already includes everything you need to coach. Elite adds the support on top. See Elite on the pricing page for the price where you are.

faqs.question: Who qualifies for the UESCA offer?
faqs.answer: Any coach who holds a UESCA certification. Send a copy of your certificate to info@augotraining.com, and we apply the offer to your augo account.

faqs.question: Do I need a coupon code at checkout?
faqs.answer: No. Subscribe to augo as usual, then email info@augotraining.com with your UESCA certificate and the email on your augo account. We add the 10% discount for your first 6 months ourselves.

faqs.question: Can I still get Elite if the 20 free spots are gone?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add Elite at the normal price from the pricing page, and your 10% discount on augo still applies for your first 6 months.

faqs.question: What happens after my 3 free months of Elite?
faqs.answer: Elite continues at the normal price unless you remove it. Let us know at info@augotraining.com if you'd rather not keep it.
